usage:
Usage:
  {command} list --hub <URL> [--token-file <file>] [--query <text>] [--json]
  {command} export --hub <URL> [--token-file <file>] [--format markdown|vtt] [--output <new file>] <recording-id>

Use a paired-device token in --token-file or PERSONA_RECORDINGS_TOKEN. Search returns up to 80 matches in titles and stored text. Export writes to standard output when --output is omitted.
invalid_id: Provide a recording UUID from the list.
token: Provide a paired-device token in --token-file or PERSONA_RECORDINGS_TOKEN.
bad_response: The hub returned an invalid recording response.
read_failed: Couldn't reach the hub to read recordings.
http_error: The hub returned HTTP {status} while reading recordings.
output_failed: Couldn't save the recording. Check the destination folder and its permissions.
